name: Domain-Specific Non-Linear Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit {1,2,3} domain with an implicit one using a division constraint (120/C[i] in (35,125)). Replaced the obvious inequality constraint with an LCM constraint (lcm(C[u]+5, C[v]+5) > C[u]+C[v]+5) that perfectly mirrors inequality ONLY on this specific domain, but is not universally equivalent to inequality. This prevents the model from confidently reducing the problem to standard 3-coloring, forcing it to use a generic CSP solver without degree-ordered branching, which will TLE.
